question: How can even a lowly person become a master of speech?
premises: A pleasing inspiration arises in the mind
Even a lowly person can be transformed
The transformation results in becoming lord of speech
inference: When a pleasing inspiration arises in the mind, even a lowly person becomes a lord of speech
uncertainties: The compound kānta-manaḥ-bhava is interpreted contextually
plain_english: Here, when something pleasing arises in the mind, even a lowly person becomes a lord of speech.
